original_question: On which chromosome is the gene associated with the type 2A form of Megalencephalic leukoencephalopathy with subcortical cysts located?

final_qi.question: On which chromosome is the gene associated with the type 2A form of Megalencephalic leukoencephalopathy with subcortical cysts located?
final_qi.long_answer: Type 2A Megalencephalic leukoencephalopathy with subcortical cysts (MLC2A) results from recessive mutations in the HEPACAM (GlialCAM) gene. This gene is situated on the long arm of chromosome 11 (11q24), so the chromosome involved is chromosome 11.
